The petition coming on for hearing, upon perusing the Petition and the affidavit filed in support thereof and upon hearing the arguments of SRI MD SALEEM Advocate for the Petitioner, and of GP for Municipal Administration and Urban Development, for the Respondent Nos.1 & 3, and  B.SRINIVAS, Standing Counsel for the Respondent No.2, and the Court made the following ORDER:
"In the present Writ Petition, the Petitioner is questioning the departmental enquiry initiated against her on the ground that the nature of allegation In the departmental enquiry is beyond the scope of departmental enquiry.

The Article of Charge framed against the Petitioner reads as under:
"Article:- Smt. M. Srilakshmi, Dy.Exe.Engineer was arrested on 28.5.2024 and sent for Judicial custody at Sub Jail, Tirupati, on the allegation that she involved in attempt to murder case was registered against her vide FIR No. 158/2024,
dt:25.05.2024 u/s 307, 324, 120-B r/w 34 IPC at Alipiri PS, Tirupati, On 25.5.2024 at 6:30 AM to 6:45 AM she and her husband Sri Girish Kumar Reddy with the active connivance of two unknown male accused persons and attached Sri N.Venkata Siva Reddy with the common intention to kill Sri N.Venkata Siva Reddy, due to previous enmity in between the accused family and the injured person Sri N.Vekata Siva Reddy.
That the said Smt. M. Srilakshmi, Dy.Exe.Engineer, GIS No. 15064, O/o EE(QC),
TTD, Tirupati has exhibited gross misconduct & defamed the image of the TTD and violated Rule-3 and 3-C of A.P.C.S (Conduct) Rules, 1964 read with Rule-4 of TTD Service Rules issued in G.O.Ms.No.1060 of Revenue (Endt-I) Dept., dt: 24.10.1989."

sentences.text: A reading of the Article of Charge above shows that the Petitioner is sought to be proceeded in a disciplinary enquiry with regard to attempt to murder case registered against her.
Learned Standing Counsel for TTD seeks time to get instructions.

Considering the nature of Article of Charge framed in the departmental enquiry, prima facie this Court Is of the opinion that enquiries into such charges are beyond the scope of departmental enquiry therefore, there shall be an interim stay of the departmental enquiry pending further orders.
Post after six weeks."
